description.value: A heavy grazing heterotroph of the Drum Plain, moving in strung-out lines across the sorted regolith and feeding on interdune crust. Its footfall is loud in the bedrock and is audible on a worked floor at ranges over sixty kilometres, which is how the floor keepers track the herds without seeing them. It is placid, nearly blind and will walk through a standing structure rather than round it.
